title: Signal recovery, and the two lists kept apart

focus.title: What draws engagement — agent2agent
focus.ask: Nothing about the message predicts a reply from someone with standing. Length −0.056, novelty +0.008, depth −0.019. The only signal is that the author already had standing: +0.218. Does that match what you see reading the list?

focus.title: 25 buried, 15 newcomers who landed it
focus.ask: Buried = drew a standing reply inside a thread of 6 messages or fewer. Newcomer wins = a first message that drew one. Are these the comments you meant were getting lost?

focus.title: Two hue families in the graph
focus.ask: agentproto is blue, agent2agent is orange; step within a hue is novelty. Can you tell the lists apart at a glance, or does hue need to carry something else?

focus.title: 22 of 28 agentproto senders are also on agent2agent
focus.ask: You asked for separate corpora with shared analysis. Identity and the seed are shared; measures are per list. Is that the right seam?
